items.stem: Why is a task-level view more useful than a whole-job view when assessing AI impact?

options.text: Most jobs are a mix of tasks, only some of which AI affects
options.rationale: Correct: AI typically changes specific tasks, not entire roles at once.

options.text: Every job is fully automated or not at all
options.rationale: Jobs are rarely all-or-nothing for automation.

options.text: Tasks never change with new technology
Whole-job views are always more accurate

items.explanation: Correct: AI typically changes specific tasks, not entire roles at once.

items.stem: Which TWO practices support a responsible AI workforce transition? (Select TWO.)

options.text: Communicate changes clearly and early to affected people
options.rationale: Correct: transparent communication builds trust during change.

options.text: Offer reskilling pathways for affected roles
options.rationale: Correct: reskilling helps people move with the change.
Silent automation erodes trust and fairness.

items.explanation: Correct: transparent communication builds trust during change.

options.text: Assess fairness, access and inclusion impacts and address gaps
options.rationale: Correct: responsible adoption checks for and closes equity gaps.
Benefits are often uneven and need checking.
